title: Crystal Clear Bar Salts White Peach Razz Nic Salts 10ml E-Liquid
description: Crystal Clear White Peach Razz Nic Salt blends delicate White Peach with sharp, juicy Raspberry. The Peach offers soft sweetness, while Raspberry lifts the flavour with subtle tartness. A well-balanced fruit vape with gentle contrast. Formulated at a 50VG/50PG ratio, this Nic Salt is ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping using refillable pod kits and vape pens. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths for a smooth throat hit and fast-absorbing nicotine. Crystal Clear Nic Salts are crafted to deliver the same great-tasting flavours that made disposable vapes so popular, now reimagined for refillable pod kits. Designed for clarity, consistency and convenience, this UK-made range focuses on fruity, icy, and confectionery-inspired blends that cater to everyday vapers.
